blocks.text: Director Nathan Fielder’s notable works such as The Rehearsal and Nathan For You typically involve his direct interaction with his subjects onscreen. When he got the go signal to do a documentary on infamous Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes however, he initially decided not to be on camera. At first, he would respond from behind the lens in brief moments, but he and his partner director Lance Oppenheim realised that they needed a foil to challenge Holmes and her current partner Billy Evans. “We started to think, ‘We can’t just give them a platform to say whatever they want to say with […]...
